name: @assistant-ui/core
notes: Required runtime beneath @assistant-ui/react; installed automatically. Declares @assistant-ui/store and @assistant-ui/tap as required peers. Ships src and source maps, hence the 9.9 MB unpacked size. Measured 21.7 MB install with React.

build_vs_buy.rationale: The runtime is the expensive layer: message parts, adapters and state transitions across providers.
